# upset { #geneinfo.plot.upset }

`geneinfo.plot.upset`

upset.py  v0.6.0
==================
UpSet-style intersection plot where the count bars are replaced by stacked
gene (or any element) name labels that grow upward from a shared baseline,
visually resembling a bar chart.

**Column layout** is decided independently per column based on the number of
genes it contains, controlled by *two_col_threshold* (default 15):

* **≤ threshold** → single centered column at 1 × *col_width*.
* **> threshold** → paired two-sub-column layout at 2 × *col_width*.
  Shorter names are left-aligned on the left sub-column; longer names are
  right-aligned on the right sub-column, so each row spans the full column
  width in proportion to combined name length.

The dot in the matrix panel is always centred in its column regardless of
width.  The figure background is transparent.

**Wrapping**: when *wrap=True* the *max_cols* intersections-per-row limit is
respected and additional rows are added below, producing a single figure with
multiple stacked gene+matrix panel pairs — one per row of columns.

**Intersection semantics** are controlled by *mode*:

* ``'exclusive'`` (default) — a gene appears in exactly one column.
* ``'inclusive'`` — a gene appears in every column whose listed sets are a
  subset of the sets that gene belongs to.

## Quickstart {.doc-section .doc-section-quickstart}

    from geneinfo.plot import upset
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    sets = {
        "Cancer drivers": {"TP53", "BRCA1", "KRAS", "PTEN", "EGFR", "APC"},
        "PI3K pathway":   {"PTEN", "KRAS", "AKT1", "MTOR", "EGFR", "PIK3CA"},
        "DNA repair":     {"BRCA1", "TP53", "ATM", "CHEK2", "PTEN", "MLH1"},
    }
    fig = upset(sets, title="Gene set overlaps")
    fig.savefig("overlaps.pdf", bbox_inches="tight", transparent=True)
    plt.show()

### compute_intersections { #geneinfo.plot.upset.compute_intersections }

```python
geneinfo.plot.upset.compute_intersections(
    sets,
    *,
    min_size=1,
    sort_by='size',
    max_cols=30,
    singletons=True,
    mode='exclusive',
)
```

Compute pairwise/n-way intersections.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**sets**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [set](`set`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Mapping of label -> element collection.

<code>[**min_size**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [1]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Discard intersections smaller than this.

<code>[**sort_by**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'size\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   ``'size'`` - largest intersection first (default). ``'degree'`` - most sets involved first, then by size.

<code>[**max_cols**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [30]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Truncate output to at most this many intersections after sorting. When called from ``upset`` with ``wrap=True`` this cap is applied per row rather than to the total.

<code>[**singletons**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   If ``False``, remove degree-1 intersections before the ``max_cols`` cap so they cannot crowd out genuine multi-set overlaps.

<code>[**mode**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'exclusive\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   ``'exclusive'`` (default) — each column shows elements that belong to *exactly* the listed sets and no others.  ``'inclusive'`` — each column shows elements that belong to *at least* the listed sets; they may also appear in other sets.  A gene shared by A, B, and C will appear in the A∩B, A∩C, B∩C, and A∩B∩C columns simultaneously.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [list of ``(frozenset\[str\], list\[str\])``]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Each tuple is *(set_labels_in_intersection, sorted_element_list)*.

```python
geneinfo.plot.upset.upset(
    sets,
    *,
    min_size=1,

    max_labels=None,
    singletons=False,
    mode='exclusive',
    wrap=False,
    color=True,
    cmap='tab10',
    col_width=1.0,
    gene_row_h=0.14,
    set_row_h=0.28,
    size_bar_cols=4.0,
    gene_pad=0.04,
    two_col_threshold=15,
    two_col_ratio=1.5,
    figsize=None,
    gene_fontsize=6.5,
    gene_fontfamily='monospace',
    gene_color=None,
    gene_fontweight='normal',
    count_fontsize=None,
    count_color=None,
    label_fontsize=None,
    label_color=None,
    label_fontweight='bold',
    label_fontfamily='sans-serif',
    title=None,
    title_fontsize=None,
    title_fontweight='bold',
    dot_size=5.5,
    dot_filled_color=None,
    dot_empty_color=None,
    col_divider_color=None,
    col_divider_lw=0.4,
    baseline_color=None,
    baseline_lw=0.9,
    row_grid_color=None,
    row_grid_lw=0.4,
    size_bar_color=None,
    size_bar_alpha=0.4,
    show_set_sizes=True,
    show_size_bars=True,
    bars=False,
    show_count=True,
    truncate_suffix='...',
    highlight=None,
    highlight_color='#F0EEE8',
)
```

Draw an UpSet-style intersection plot where stacked gene names replace the
conventional count bars, growing upward from a shared baseline.

**Column layout** is decided independently per column:

* Columns with **≤ two_col_threshold** genes use a **single centered
  stack** at 1 × *col_width*.
* Columns with **> two_col_threshold** genes use a **paired two-sub-column
  layout** at 2 × *col_width*: shorter names left-aligned on the left
  half, longer names right-aligned on the right half.

The dot in the matrix panel is always centred in its column.  The figure
background is fully transparent.

**Wrapping**: when *wrap=True*, all intersections are computed without the
*max_cols* cap, then laid out *max_cols* columns at a time.  Each group of
columns occupies one gene-panel + matrix-panel pair, and the pairs are
stacked vertically within a single figure.  Set-name labels and size bars
are repeated on every row so each row is self-contained.

**Intersection semantics** are controlled by *mode*:

* ``'exclusive'`` (default) — a gene appears in exactly one column.
* ``'inclusive'`` — a gene appears in every column whose listed sets are
  a subset of the sets that gene belongs to.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**sets**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), \'set \| list\'\] \| [List](`typing.List`)\[[GeneList](`geneinfo.genelist.GeneList`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Gene (or any element) sets to compare.  Values can be ``set`` or ``list``; duplicates are ignored.

<code>[**min_size**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [1]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Discard intersections with fewer than this many elements.

<code>[**sort_by**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'size\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Column ordering: ``'size'`` — largest intersection first (default); ``'degree'`` — most sets involved first, then by size.

<code>[**max_cols**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [15]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Without wrapping: hard cap on the number of columns displayed. With ``wrap=True``: number of intersection columns per row. Singletons are filtered *before* this cap when ``singletons=False``.

<code>[**max_labels**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[int](`int`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Cap on gene labels shown per column.  ``None`` = unlimited.

<code>[**singletons**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   If ``False`` (default), degree-1 intersections (genes unique to a single set) are excluded before the *max_cols* cap is applied.

<code>[**mode**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'exclusive\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   ``'exclusive'`` (default) or ``'inclusive'``.  See above.

<code>[**wrap**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   If ``True``, ignore the *max_cols* truncation and instead lay out all intersections across multiple rows, *max_cols* columns each. Each row is a complete gene-panel + matrix-panel pair with set labels repeated on the left.  Default ``False``.

<code>[**color**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   If ``True`` (default), each set gets a distinct colour from *cmap* applied to its label, size bar, and filled dots.  Gene name text always uses the theme foreground.  ``False`` → monochrome.

<code>[**cmap**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'tab10\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Matplotlib colormap name for ``color=True``.  Defaults to ``'tab10'``; auto-upgraded to ``'tab20'`` for > 10 sets.

<code>[**col_width**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [1.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Width of a narrow (single-column) intersection column in inches. Wide (two-column) columns are 2 × *col_width*.

<code>[**gene_row_h**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.14]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Vertical space per gene-label row in inches.

<code>[**set_row_h**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.28]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Height of each set row in the dot-matrix panel in inches.

<code>[**size_bar_cols**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [4.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Width of the set-label + size-bar region in *col_width* units. Overridden when ``bars=False``.

<code>[**gene_pad**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.04]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Gap between a column divider and the nearest gene-name character, as a fraction of a column width.  Wide columns only.  Default 0.04.

<code>[**two_col_threshold**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[int](`int`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [15]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Columns with **more than** this many genes use the wide two-column layout (2 × *col_width*); others use the narrow single layout. Default 15.

<code>[**figsize**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[tuple](`tuple`)\[[float](`float`), [float](`float`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Override auto figure size ``(width_in, height_in)``.

<code>[**gene_fontsize**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [6.5]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font size for gene name labels (pt).  Default 6.5.

<code>[**gene_fontfamily**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'monospace\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font family for gene name labels.  Default ``'monospace'``.

<code>[**gene_color**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Colour for gene name labels.  ``None`` → theme foreground.

<code>[**gene_fontweight**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'normal\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font weight for gene name labels.  Default ``'normal'``.

<code>[**count_fontsize**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[float](`float`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font size for intersection-count labels.  Defaults to ``gene_fontsize - 0.5``.

<code>[**count_color**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Colour for count labels and truncation markers. ``None`` → theme foreground at ~45 % opacity.

<code>[**label_fontsize**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[float](`float`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font size for set name labels.  Defaults to ``gene_fontsize + 0.5``.

<code>[**label_color**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Colour for set name labels.  ``None`` → theme foreground (or set colour when ``color=True``).

<code>[**label_fontweight**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'bold\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font weight for set name labels.  Default ``'bold'``.

<code>[**label_fontfamily**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'sans-serif\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font family for set name labels.  Default ``'sans-serif'``.

<code>[**title**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Optional figure title string (placed above the first row).

<code>[**title_fontsize**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[float](`float`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font size for the figure title.  Defaults to ``gene_fontsize + 4``.

<code>[**title_fontweight**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\'bold\']{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Font weight for the figure title.  Default ``'bold'``.

<code>[**dot_size**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [5.5]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Dot-matrix circle diameter (matplotlib marker-size units).

<code>[**dot_filled_color**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Colour of filled dots.  ``None`` → theme foreground (or set colour).

<code>[**size_bar_color**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

<code>[**size_bar_alpha**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[float](`float`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.4]{.parameter-default}</code>

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Basic usage::

    upset({"A": {"x","y"}, "B": {"y","z"}, "C": {"z","x"}})
    

Wrap all intersections across multiple rows, 12 columns per row::

    fig = upset(my_sets, wrap=True, max_cols=12, singletons=True)
    fig.savefig("wrapped.pdf", bbox_inches="tight", transparent=True)

Inclusive mode with per-set colour::

    upset(
        my_sets,
        mode="inclusive",
        color=True,
        cmap="Set2",
        gene_fontsize=7,
        title="Shared gene sets",
    )

Dark theme::

    with plt.style.context("dark_background"):
        upset(my_sets)

Highlight a specific intersection::

    upset(
        my_sets,
        highlight=[frozenset(["Cancer drivers", "DNA repair"])],
    )
